title: Finite scalar tensor normalization of the assembled strict map
statement: For every pair of integral cochain complexes, the unique strict map of [lem-coef-tensor-reduction-strict-assembly] satisfies the finite scalar tensor equation: evaluation followed by coefficientEvaluationTensorIso and the tensor of the inverse reduction/evaluation identifications equals the inverse reduction/evaluation identification on the total tensor followed by coefficientScalarTensorIso. The comparisons come from [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core] and [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. No good-complex or derived-localization hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 07A4, finite tensor equation in step 1 of lem-coef-tensor-reduction-ordinary-model

proof.text: Rewrite the evaluation of the strict map using tensorReductionStrictMap_component. By the definition of the finite component, cancel the evaluation tensor isomorphism against its inverse. Functoriality of the finite total tensor identifies the composite of the tensor of the two forward reduction/evaluation maps with the tensor of their two inverses as the image of the identity pair. Iso inverse laws and map_id finish the equality. The categorical cancellation is proved on an arbitrary product functor before applying it to these complexes.

theorem tensorReductionStrictMap_finite (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    let T := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P, Q)
    let G := (pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (tensorReductionStrictMap l E W P Q) ≫
      (coefficientEvaluationTensorIso l E W n (G.obj P) (G.obj Q)).hom ≫
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n)).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E W n).inv.app P)
          ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E W n).inv.app Q)) =
      (pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E W n).inv.app T ≫
        (coefficientScalarTensorIso l E W n P Q).hom
